<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_CreditScoring" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ClerkRequest" name="Credit scoring requested"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DelayNotice" name="Scoring delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FinalResult" name="Scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SalesClerk" name="Sales clerk (frontend)"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Banking" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Credit scoring agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ClerkRequest" name="Request scoring" sourceRef="Participant_SalesClerk" targetRef="StartEvent_ClerkRequest" messageRef="Msg_ClerkRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="SendTask_ScoringRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate result" sourceRef="SendTask_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Catch_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Msg_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="SendTask_DelayNotice" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotice" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FinalResult" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="SendTask_FinalResult" targetRef="Catch_FinalResult" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DelayMessageToClerk" name="Delay message" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelay" targetRef="Participant_SalesClerk"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ResultToClerk" name="Result" sourceRef="Task_PresentResult" targetRef="Participant_SalesClerk"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking credit scoring process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ClerkRequest" name="Credit scoring requested">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ClerkRequest" messageRef="Msg_ClerkRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_Response" name="Agency response">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Msg_ImmediateResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DelayNotice" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayDelay" name="Display delay message to clerk">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_FinalResult" name="Scoring result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FinalResult" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResultMerge" name="Result available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PresentResult" name="Present result to clerk">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ResultShown" name="Result shown at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ClerkRequest" targetRef="SendTask_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B2" sourceRef="SendTask_ScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Response"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B3" sourceRef="Gateway_Response" targetRef="Catch_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B4" sourceRef="Gateway_Response" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B5" sourceRef="Catch_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Gateway_ResultMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B6" sourceRef="Catch_DelayNotice" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B7" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelay" targetRef="Catch_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B8" sourceRef="Catch_FinalResult" targetRef="Gateway_ResultMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B9" sourceRef="Gateway_ResultMerge" targetRef="Task_PresentResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B10" sourceRef="Task_PresentResult" targetRef="EndEvent_ResultShown"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Credit scoring agency process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1" name="Perform level 1 scoring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Level1Split" name="Result determined immediately?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ImmediateResult" name="Return immediate result to banking process" messageRef="Msg_ImmediateResult">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate result returned">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_DelayNotice" name="Inform banking process of delay" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2" name="Perform level 2 scoring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_FinalResult" name="Return scoring result to banking process" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FinalResult" name="Level 2 result returned">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ScoringRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_Level1" targetRef="Gateway_Level1Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Split" targetRef="SendTask_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Split" targetRef="SendTask_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="SendTask_ImmediateResult" targetRef="EndEvent_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="SendTask_DelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_Level2" targetRef="SendTask_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="SendTask_FinalResult" targetRef="EndEvent_FinalResult"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
